about: A Pokemon that faints in its battle form comes back in its own: Twins Amy & Mimi in the Azalea Gym against a scratch copy of Paolo's Bugsy save with two Pokemon, a level-20 Pawmot and a level-10 Aegislash. The Aegislash turns to its Blade Forme for its Shadow Sneak and the Spinarak's faints it, with no one left to take its place; the next turn the Pawmot's Revival Blessing (teach:) revives it and the turn's end sends it into its empty place in its Shield Forme, so its next Shadow Sneak turns it to the Blade Forme again (before BtlCmd_PlayFaintAnimation put the form back, it came back as SPECIES_AEGISLASH_BLADE, with the Blade Forme's stats and no line).

lines: Aegislash was revived and is ready to fight again!
